claim_one_line: LISTENING 30, THE NULL CONTROL (PROVED for its checks; data-free): the whole's small group with the same six moves, acting on the cosets of every class of its subgroups (45 at mod 27, 100 at mod 81), halves in the whole's form p_neutral(2x)/2^d = (x^2 - 9) x S(x) on 4 and 8 of them, fewer than one in ten, the whole's own orbit among them; on about two thirds the charged modes do not even pair; every coset space that halves has omega's exchange fixing exactly three points and rho non-trivial on its stabiliser, and (post hoc) is a quotient of the whole's own orbit, though half or more of those quotients do not halve; so the halving is a property of the whole's orbit within its group, not of the group's action
